name: slowtrail
description: 星河逐影 (SlowTrail) - MySQL 慢 SQL 透视分析平台

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --raw "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run electron:wait"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:electron
scripts.prepare:native:mac: node scripts/prepare-native-electron.js --platform darwin --arch x64 && node scripts/prepare-native-electron.js --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.pack: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:all: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native:win && npm run prepare:native:mac && npm run prepare:native:linux && electron-builder --win --mac --linux --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native:win && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native:mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && npm run prepare:native:linux && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.js
